proposals.premise: Task-first guidance reflects that members often know the job but not the tool name; plain recommendations make the lab feel beginner-trusting.
proposals.opening: Desktop shows “What are you trying to do?” beside current availability; phone shows the task prompt first, followed by availability and staffed collection times.
proposals.move: Selecting a task reveals suitable tools, restrictions, and pickup windows below; an available item can then be requested and confirmed with eligibility and collection time.
proposals.tradeoff: Beginners avoid tool vocabulary, but members who already know the tool take an extra selection step.

proposals.premise: Assume the unresolved decision is collection, since every three-day loan must begin Tuesday 18–20 or Saturday 10–14; organize inventory around that constraint.
proposals.opening: Desktop opens with the two collection windows sharing space with available inventory; phone shows the windows first, then tools available for the chosen pickup.
proposals.move: Choosing a window filters the list in place; requesting an iron checks induction, while the supervised-bench multimeter has no loan control, and confirmation appears below.
proposals.tradeoff: Feasible requests emerge quickly, but suitability guidance arrives later for members unsure which tool fits.
